description.value:
You woke up somewhere with no memory of how you got there, or who you were before. No name came to mind, no home, no face you recognized as family — just the fact of being alive, and a single object that might be the only thread back to whoever you used to be.

You've had to learn the world over again from strangers' explanations, piecing together a life from context clues and the occasional flash of half-remembered detail.

toolProficiencies: Choose one from disguise kit, forgery kit, or tinker's implements
system.equipment: A set of common clothes, a relic of your forgotten past, and a belt pouch containing 200 credits.
